digest.component_or_area: Model fallback chain configuration and capability resolution
propositions: The fallback chain mechanism currently computes capability intersection up-front across all candidates before attempt, which silently downgrades native structured output to prompted output for standard-class calls when a prompted-only fallback is configured.

Direct Anthropic Sonnet has been live-proven to support native structured output and thinking via non-interactive credential, but the rebar.toml configuration lacks the approved fallback arms for frontier and standard model classes.

The existing whole-chain capability intersection design is intentional (not a bug) per prior tickets, but the operator-approved superseding design requires per-attempt capability resolution so fallback chains do not degrade primary model capabilities.
Mixed Bedrock/Anthropic chains must conservatively disable prompt caching due to provider-specific cache style differences, even though per-attempt capability resolution would otherwise be feasible.
Trivial-class fallback remains single-arm (Bedrock Haiku only) because direct Haiku native-output capability parity has not been measured or recorded.

A separate credential-shadowing defect exists where valid direct-Anthropic credentials in interactive contexts are shadowed by invalid credentials in non-interactive agent/gate environments, preventing fallback execution despite chain configuration.
